            int currentTurnLowerTaken
          • currentTurnUpperTaken
            int currentTurnUpperTaken
            Authoritative per-turn pick counters for the player currently acting in ACTION_RESOLUTION. Kept in the model (not in the controller state) so they are part of the snapshot/DTO — the views read these instead of guessing with their own local counters, which used to drift from the server and cause spurious "no more picks allowed" rejections. Reset when the turn passes to the next player.

            int numPlayers
            Number of players inside the game

            Current game phase
